[EN] Thulsa stole titanic essense from the Tower of Shara.
[ES] Thulsa robó esencia titánica de la Tower of Shara.

[EN] What he needs it for is unclear,
but I’m sure he’s up to no good.
[ES] No está claro para qué la necesita,
pero estoy seguro de que trama algo malo.

[EN] It must be retrieved before it’s too late.
[ES] Hay que recuperarla antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

[EN] Let's talk on the way.
Follow me.
[ES] Hablemos en el camino.
Sígueme.

[EN] Anyway, that woman who was with Thulsa...
[ES] En fin, esa mujer que estaba con Thulsa...

[EN] I don't know...
I have a bad feeling about her.
[ES] No lo sé...
Tengo un mal presentimiento sobre ella.

[EN] Ah...
Things are getting annoying.
[ES] Ah...
Las cosas se están poniendo fastidiosas.
